bites.title: The Add menu
bites.body: Shift+A is yours now. It opens the Add menu, the shop where every new object comes from. New things appear at the 3D cursor: that red and white ring.

bites.title: Move the drop point
bites.body: Hold Shift and right-click somewhere on the grid. The 3D cursor jumps there. That's where your next object will land.
bites.hint: Shift+Right-click on the floor grid, away from the cube.

bites.title: Summon a sphere
bites.body: Hover the viewport, press Shift+A, then Mesh, then UV Sphere.
bites.hint: Shift+A opens the menu right under your mouse. Mesh is near the top.

bites.title: Change your mind
bites.body: See the little panel in the bottom-left corner? It only exists right after you add or change something. Click it open and push Segments up to 64. Watch the sphere get smoother.
bites.hint: Bottom-left corner: a collapsed panel named UV Sphere. Click its title, then drag or type in Segments.

bites.title: Make it vanish
bites.body: With the sphere selected, press X, then click Delete. Gone.
bites.hint: X pops a tiny confirm menu. The Delete key skips it.

bites.title: Copy that
bites.body: Press Shift+D to duplicate the cube, move the mouse, and click to drop the copy. Shift+D copies and grabs in one move.
bites.hint: The cube needs to be orange (selected). Then Shift+D, move, click.

bites.title: Meet Suzanne
bites.body: Shift+A, Mesh, Monkey. This is Suzanne, Blender's monkey mascot and favorite test subject.

bites.title: Monkey on a box
bites.body: Put Suzanne on top of the original cube. G moves her. G then Z locks the move to up and down. Front view (numpad 1) makes it easy to judge.
bites.hint: Slide her over the cube first (G, click), then G, Z to lift her. Numpad 1 to check from the front.

bites.title: Lesson 02: cleared
bites.body:
You can place the cursor, add, tweak, delete, duplicate, and stack. You build things now.

Reward: the Outliner just slid in on the right. It lists every object in your scene. Scroll on for Lesson 03: Organizing.
